# tg

- AGENTS.md — primary guide for AI coding agents (constraints, layout, commands, build)
- README.md — human-oriented docs (install, BotFather, examples, pitfalls)
- skills/tg/SKILL.md — usage skill: sending Telegram alerts/files with the tg CLI, chat_id via `tg whoami`, exit codes
- skills/tg-dev/SKILL.md — repo workflow skill (constraints, build/test, PR flow)
